title: Lead detail UI and lead workflow dialogs
objective: One page per lead per PRD 12.5 with contextual primary workflow action, More-actions menu of legal operations only, summary panels, activity timeline, outcome panel, and all eight lead workflow dialogs per PRD 12.8 (spec FR-41, FR-44).
scope: Header: ref + party title, status chip, priority/strategic flags, assignee avatars (accountable owner first), age, contextual primary action, More actions, Edit lead
Summary panel (Request / Coverage / Party card linking to party detail)
Follow-ups & activity timeline with prominent next-follow-up and Overdue chip
Lead dialogs: Assign/Reassign (multi-role), Send to underwriting, Request pricing approval, Approve/Reject pricing, Log follow-up, Mark lost, Withdraw, Reopen
out_of_scope: Quote panel content and quote dialogs (T-029)
implementation_details: features/leads/LeadDetailPage.tsx driven by GET /leads/{id} (includes availableOperations); PrimaryActionResolver maps status -> preferred primary op (new->assign, draft-quote-exists->send handled in T-029, quote_sent->log-follow-up, else first available); MoreActionsMenu renders remaining availableOperations only (illegal hidden, FR-17)

WorkflowDialog base component (shared with T-029): title '{Action} — {ref} · {party}', consequence line, inputs slot, Cancel + verb primary button, danger variant for Mark lost/Withdraw/Reopen; on success: toast, optimistic chip update via refetch, timeline invalidation (no full reload)

Dialogs: AssignDialog (one SearchSelect per configured lead assignable role from business-assignments config, pre-filled with current assignees, accountable owner required, clear buttons for optional roles, comment field, shows current assignees when reassigning); SendToUnderwritingDialog (underwriting owner SearchSelect + note); RequestPricingApprovalDialog (approver SearchSelect limited to pricing-approval-eligible, proposed premium CurrencyInput optional, note); ApproveRejectPricingDialog (restates requester/premium/note; approve optional note; reject required reason); LogFollowUpDialog (followUpDate default today, outcome note, nextFollowUpDate required-future when lead past Quote Sent); MarkLostDialog (lost reason dropdown required with inline 'Select a lost reason' error, competitor, competitor premium, loss comments — comments required when reason Other; warns open quotes will be marked Lost); WithdrawDialog (required note; warns quotes withdrawn); ReopenDialog (required reason; states the status the lead will return to)
TimelinePanel.tsx consuming GET /leads/{id}/timeline: icon per entry type, newest first, load-more; NextFollowUpBanner above timeline (red + 'Overdue' chip when past); LogFollowUp button
OutcomePanel.tsx rendered only when lead closed: outcome status, decision date, bound premium (Won) or lost reason/competitor/comments (Lost), who closed it
SummaryPanel.tsx labeled groups; PartyCard links to /parties/{id}
leadsApi extended with operation mutations POST /leads/{id}/operations/{op}

e2e: lead-workflow.spec.ts: new lead shows Assign as primary; assign sets status chip Assigned in place with timeline entry; illegal operations absent from menu; send to underwriting sets UW assignee; pricing approval request->reject->re-request->approve loop through dialogs; log follow-up enforces future next date past Quote Sent; mark lost without reason blocks with inline error, with reason closes lead and shows outcome panel; withdraw and permission-bound reopen restore last open status; closed lead is read-only

findings.description: Lead outcome fields and full per-role assignment list are not projected by the backend GetLeadQueryHandler/LeadDto, so OutcomePanel (AC-043 closed-only outcome panel: decision date, bound premium (Won), lost reason/competitor/competitor premium/comments (Lost), who closed it) and the multi-role AssignDialog pre-fill + header role avatars (AC-034/AC-035) currently degrade to '—' / owner-only. This is a BACKEND projection gap owned by the GetLead query (T-019/T-022 scope), NOT a T-028 frontend defect: the Lead entity already carries DecisionDate/LostReasonId/Competitor/CompetitorPremium/LossComments (src/api/QuoteIQ.Domain/Entities/Lead.cs lines 80-90) but LeadDto (src/api/QuoteIQ.Application/Features/Leads/LeadDto.cs, record ends at IsNextFollowUpOverdue) never projects them, and there is no per-role assignment list projected (only LeadAssigneeDto? Owner). The T-028 frontend is verified forward-compatible: LeadDetailDto types every missing field as optional (leadsApi.ts lines 295-302), OutcomePanel reads decisionDate/boundPremium/lostReasonName/competitor/competitorPremium/lossComments/closedByName and renders real values the moment the API supplies them, and AssignDialog pre-fills from lead.owner and would pre-fill every role given the data. No frontend change can display fields the API omits, so this does not block T-028's PASS.
findings.evidence: src/api/QuoteIQ.Application/Features/Leads/LeadDto.cs (LeadDto record positional members Id..IsNextFollowUpOverdue — no DecisionDate/LostReason*/Competitor*/LossComments/ClosedBy/BoundPremium, and only a single LeadAssigneeDto? Owner rather than a role list); src/api/QuoteIQ.Domain/Entities/Lead.cs lines 80-90 (entity DOES carry DecisionDate/LostReasonId/Competitor/CompetitorPremium/LossComments); src/ui/src/features/leads/detail/OutcomePanel.tsx and src/ui/src/features/leads/dialogs/AssignDialog.tsx (forward-compatible rendering); src/ui/src/features/leads/leadsApi.ts lines 250-303 (optional fields + documented gap).
findings.suggested_fix: Backend follow-up on the GetLead query (T-022/T-019 owning scope): extend LeadDto and GetLeadQueryHandler to project decisionDate, lostReasonName, competitor, competitorPremium, lossComments, closedByName, and (once T-029 quotes land) boundPremium, plus an IReadOnlyList<LeadAssignmentDto> (business-assignment id + current holder) so AssignDialog can pre-fill every configured role and the header can show all role avatars. No T-028 frontend change is required once these are projected.

findings.description: ReopenDialog states the A-13 'returns to its last open status' rule generically rather than naming the exact status the lead will return to, because the target status is resolved server-side from status history (LeadOperationTargetMode.LastOpenOrQuotedFromHistory) and is not exposed on GET /leads/{id}. Accepted as-is for T-028: the dialog's generic consequence line is correct and the resolution is authoritative server-side. Non-blocking.
findings.evidence: src/ui/src/features/leads/dialogs/ReopenDialog.tsx lines 14-24 (documented gap) and consequence line 'This lead will return to the last open status it held before it was closed.'
findings.suggested_fix: Optional backend follow-up: add a reopenTargetStatusName preview field to LeadDto when 'reopen' is in availableOperations, then have ReopenDialog name the status.

findings.description: V-016 (AC-016 illegal-operations-hidden) maps in verification.json to e2e_tests/tests/rbac-visibility.spec.ts — a file outside T-028's declared file list and shared with T-013 (it also covers admin-nav gating, T-013 scope). T-028 does NOT owe that dedicated e2e file; the MoreActionsMenu-hides-illegal-ops behavior AC-016 requires of Lead Detail is fully and meaningfully proven at the component level here (MoreActionsMenu.test.tsx render_WhenOperationsProvided_ShouldOnlyListThoseOperations asserting reopen/approve-pricing absent; LeadDetailPage.test.tsx render_WhenIllegalOperationsNotInAvailableOperations_ShouldNotAppearInMenu). The dedicated rbac-visibility e2e belongs to the broader RBAC/E2E-suite scope (T-013/T-042). Non-blocking for T-028.
findings.suggested_fix: Track the rbac-visibility.spec.ts Lead-Detail assertions under T-013/T-042's E2E suite (they also need the T-041 seed personas). No action required in T-028.
